messages.content: Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence. Write 10 prompts to generate portrait images on the occasion of Mother's Day about the Palestinian mother and imagine her as a tree with roots clinging to the ground, as a gift to her on this occasion. Make some prompts into an expressive painting of an old Palestinian mother with wrinkles filling her face and her look full of kindness and tenderness.

message.content:
Prompt 1 is a Mother’s Day gift portrait of a Palestinian mother as a living tree with roots clinging to the ground and a tender smiling face 🌷
Prompt 2 is an expressive oil-painting gift of an old Palestinian mother with deep wrinkles filling her face and her look full of kindness and tenderness as her shoulders become an olive tree with roots gripping the soil 🎨
Prompt 3 is a watercolor Mother’s Day gift portrait of a Palestinian mother with a calm smile and arms merging into tree bark while roots hold the ground and pomegranates rest at her feet 🌸
Prompt 4 is a painterly Mother’s Day gift close-up of an old Palestinian mother with wrinkles on her face and kind eyes and soft hands like leaves and a tree crown above her head with roots clutching the earth 🌿
Prompt 5 is a realistic digital Mother’s Day gift portrait of a Palestinian mother as a living tree with roots intertwined with the ground and olive fruits in her hair and a warm compassionate face 🕊️
Prompt 6 is an expressive gouache Mother’s Day gift painting of an old Palestinian mother with a lined face and tender expression and a fig tree body and roots clinging tightly to the land and Palestinian embroidery in warm tones 🧶
Prompt 7 is a symbolic Mother’s Day gift portrait of a Palestinian mother with a kind face and roots spreading through cracked soil and olive branches framing her and a soft dawn glow 🌅
Prompt 8 is an intimate Mother’s Day gift portrait of an old Palestinian mother with wrinkles filled with love and a gentle expression and branches for arms and roots anchoring her to the ground and a scarf with subtle Palestinian patterns 🧣
Prompt 9 is a cinematic Mother’s Day gift portrait of a Palestinian mother as an olive tree in a courtyard with roots embracing the earth and a grandmotherly face with tender wrinkles and a warm morning light 🏡
Prompt 10 is a miniature Mother’s Day gift painting of an old Palestinian mother with a kind tender face and blossoming branches over her head and roots gripping the ground and a composition celebrating her patience and love 🎁
